title: Revenue by currency
hints: README → New syntax: an array keyed by currency, then `for (k in arr)` in `END`.
For paid orders, add the amount to `s[currency]`. In END, loop over the keys and printf each, then pipe into sort.

`printf 'x 1
y 5
x 2
' | awk '{t[$1] += $2} END {for (k in t) print k, t[k]}' | sort` prints `x 3` and `y 5`.
